extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.benefits_span: The UnitedHealthcare plan available in Polk County has a $5 monthly premium, a $530 drug deductible and a $4200 maximum out-of-pocket.

composition.summary: The agent discussed plan benefits before delivering the disclaimer, which is non-compliant. The agent collected the Scope of Appointment and scheduled a plan review, both of which were compliant.
composition.coaching_note: Owen, it's important to deliver the disclaimer before discussing any plan benefits to ensure compliance. For example, you said, 'The UnitedHealthcare plan available in Polk County has a $5 monthly premium, a $530 drug deductible and a $4200 maximum out-of-pocket.' This should have been preceded by the disclaimer. Next time, make sure to deliver the disclaimer first.
